[[Blast (enchantment)|Axiomatic Blast 3]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Blast (enchantment)|Axiomatic Blast 3]]:''' This weapon is an implement of law, dealing 3d6 Law damage on a successful hit, and an additional 3d6 Law damage on a critical hit. This effect makes the weapon lawfully aligned.
Chaotic characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.
